name: PayNote Delivery
description: Tracks delivery of a PayNote through a deliverer (e.g., bank) to a receiver (payer - client).

payNoteSender.description: Participant submitting the PayNote delivery (merchant or processor).

payNoteDeliverer.description: Participant delivering and reporting status (e.g., bank).

request.description: True when the transaction is identified.

paymentMandateBootstrapRequest.description: Optional Payment Mandate bootstrap request details for Delivery flows that require mandate attachment before proposal exposure.

cardTransactionDetails.description: Card network identifiers used to match processor and issuer records.
